ValidationRule.description: To prevent the case status transition (Closed → Open)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), OR( AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c,'Unauthorised Transaction')), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'BPAY_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PayTo_Dispute'), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Open'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot move a case from Closed to Open, if you have closed the case in error, please move the case back to 'Under Investigation' or 'On Hold'
